content.text: {"class": "TEST_DATA", "reasoning": "The shared subscription SUB-70001 was cancelled by the nightly suite #2117 (audit log, actor=svc-qa-automation) between the last green build and this run, so the test consumed a pre-existing record left in a terminal state by an earlier run rather than one it created. Under the stale-account tie-break, a wrong value in a row of the product's own data model is TEST_DATA, and the 409 SUBSCRIPTION_NOT_RENEWABLE is correct product behaviour for a CANCELLED subscription. The hard-coded ID is a reference to a record that was supposed to be ACTIVE, not a wrong expectation, so this is not TEST_CODE_DEFECT."}
